name: Graphonite-S7
description: A high-density graphene-reinforced structural panel produced by Crucible Industries using nano-lamination of 200-400 graphene sheets bonded with a ceramic-epoxy matrix. The result is a rigid panel with tensile strength exceeding legacy titanium at roughly one-third the mass. Standard production runs in 4mm and 8mm thicknesses for modular construction applications.
applications: load-bearing wall panels in mid-tier hab construction
structural framing for orbital transit modules
story_hooks: A Shelf-level fixer discovers that salvaged Graphonite-S7 panels from a demolished Tier 3 hab block are stamped with a fraudulent Crucible Industries certification — someone is running counterfeit structural materials into the construction supply chain, and buildings are quietly failing.
A structural engineer notices micro-delamination in Graphonite-S7 panels across three different buildings — all sourced from the same fabrication batch, all owned by the same corponation shell.
Graphonite-S7 offcuts and rejects are becoming the preferred armor plating for Shelf-level gang fortifications, prompting Crucible Industries to lobby for tighter scrap controls.
